evidence.evidence:
What is verified about this assessment?

The current Year 7 route uses a bespoke QUEST paper-based assessment with multiple-choice and written questions: English/VR 40 minutes, Maths/NVR 45, creative comprehension 20 and creative writing 20.

Keep the years separate. The published assessment is 20 November 2026 for September 2027 entry. January 2027 interviews are a later stage, not a relabelled 2027 written exam. A test taken in 2027 for a later entry cycle is not yet verified here.

Our original practice does not reproduce this school’s complete assessment, timing, adaptive delivery, writing marking or interview. A later cycle is not confirmed by an older specimen.

Read the school’s official assessment information →

Source checked 25 October 2026 · Published cycle checked; future-cycle changes remain unconfirmed.
